title: Direct NSF NCAR allocation listing for UTAA0012

desiredEvidence: NCAR ARC allocation listing page or CISL announcement that names allocation UTAA0012 and Project Administrator role.
whyItMatters: Promotes the present-research chapter from a self-reported claim into a directly auditable institutional record.
targetEffect: Move the present-research chapter from internal synthesis toward direct NSF NCAR confirmation.
notes: If the listing requires an NCAR account, capture a screenshot or use the public allocation report PDF instead.
